brock.name: Brock
brock.title: Pewter City Gym Leader
brock.tips: Water and Grass types are super effective. If you chose Charmander, catch a Mankey on Route 22 or Butterfree with Confusion.

misty.name: Misty
misty.title: Cerulean City Gym Leader
misty.tips: Electric types like Pikachu are great. Grass types like Oddish or Bellsprout work well too. Watch out for Starmie's high Special stat.

surge.name: Lt. Surge
surge.title: Vermilion City Gym Leader
surge.tips: Ground types are immune to Electric moves. Diglett from Diglett's Cave is perfect for this battle.

erika.name: Erika
erika.title: Celadon City Gym Leader
erika.tips: Fire and Flying types excel here. Watch out for Sleep Powder and status moves. Poison types resist Grass.

koga.name: Koga
koga.title: Fuchsia City Gym Leader
koga.tips: Psychic types dominate this gym. Ground types also work well. Watch out for Self-Destruct on Weezing!

sabrina.name: Sabrina
sabrina.title: Saffron City Gym Leader
sabrina.tips: In Gen 1, Ghost moves don't affect Psychic (bugged). Bug types are your best bet. Dark types don't exist yet.

blaine.name: Blaine
blaine.title: Cinnabar Island Gym Leader
blaine.tips: Water types are ideal. Ground and Rock types work well too. Surf is available by this point.

giovanni.name: Giovanni
giovanni.title: Viridian City Gym Leader
giovanni.tips: Water and Ice types are devastating. Watch out for Rhydon's high Attack. Grass types work but beware of Poison moves on Nidos.

lorelei.name: Lorelei
lorelei.title: Elite Four
lorelei.tips: Electric types handle most of her team. Fighting types work on Lapras and Cloyster. Watch out for Lapras.

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.title: Elite Four
bruno.tips: Psychic types destroy Fighting types. Water and Grass handle Onix easily. Flying types are also effective.

agatha.name: Agatha
agatha.title: Elite Four
agatha.tips: In Gen 1, Ghost doesn't affect Psychic (bug). Ground types hit Gengar family hard (they're part Poison). Bring Awakening items.

lance.name: Lance
lance.title: Elite Four
lance.tips: Ice types are your best friend here. Ice Beam destroys his entire team. Electric handles Gyarados. Watch out for Hyper Beam.

blue-champion.name: Blue
blue-champion.title: Pokémon League Champion
blue-champion.tips: Team varies based on your starter choice. Ice types handle many threats. Bring a diverse team with good type coverage.

falkner.name: Falkner
falkner.title: Violet City Gym Leader
falkner.tips: Rock types are ideal. Electric types work great. Geodude from Dark Cave is perfect for this battle.

bugsy.name: Bugsy
bugsy.title: Azalea Town Gym Leader
bugsy.tips: Scyther's Fury Cutter gets stronger each turn - don't let it build up! Fire and Flying types are super effective.

whitney.name: Whitney
whitney.title: Goldenrod City Gym Leader
whitney.tips: Whitney's Miltank is notorious! Use Fighting types like Machop (from Goldenrod Dept Store trade). Female Pokemon avoid Attract. Rock/Steel resists Rollout.

morty.name: Morty
morty.title: Ecruteak City Gym Leader
morty.tips: Normal types are immune to Ghost but can't hit back in Gen 2. Dark types like Umbreon work great. Bring Awakening items for Hypnosis.

chuck.name: Chuck
chuck.title: Cianwood City Gym Leader
chuck.tips: Psychic and Flying types dominate. Watch out for Poliwrath's DynamicPunch confusion. Grass resists Surf but is neutral to Fighting.

jasmine.name: Jasmine
jasmine.title: Olivine City Gym Leader
jasmine.tips: Fire and Ground types are super effective. Fighting works too. Steelix has high defense but low Special Defense.

pryce.name: Pryce
pryce.title: Mahogany Town Gym Leader
pryce.tips: Fire and Fighting types excel here. Piloswine is also Ground type, so Electric won't work on it.

clair.name: Clair
clair.title: Blackthorn City Gym Leader
clair.tips: Kingdra's Water/Dragon typing means only Dragon is super effective! Ice Beam still hits hard. Bring Paralyz Heals for Thunder Wave.

will.name: Will
will.title: Elite Four
will.tips: Dark types are immune to Psychic and super effective. Bug and Ghost also work well.

koga-e4.name: Koga
koga-e4.title: Elite Four
koga-e4.tips: Psychic types dominate. Ground handles Muk and Crobat (if grounded). Watch out for Forretress Explosion!

bruno-e4.name: Bruno
bruno-e4.title: Elite Four
bruno-e4.tips: Psychic and Flying types dominate Fighting. Water/Grass handles Onix. Machamp's No Guard makes moves always hit!

karen.name: Karen
karen.title: Elite Four
karen.tips: Fighting types handle Dark. Bug works on Umbreon. Watch out for Gengar's Ghost/Poison typing and Destiny Bond.

lance-champion.name: Lance
lance-champion.title: Pokémon League Champion
lance-champion.tips: Ice types destroy most of his team! Rock handles Charizard and Aerodactyl. Electric for Gyarados. His Dragonites are underleveled (should evolve at 55).

roxanne.name: Roxanne
roxanne.title: Rustboro City Gym Leader
roxanne.tips: Water and Grass starters dominate. If you chose Torchic, catch a Shroomish or Lotad early. Nosepass's Sturdy in ORAS can survive one strong hit.

brawly.name: Brawly
brawly.title: Dewford Town Gym Leader
brawly.tips: Flying types like Taillow and Wingull excel. Psychic moves from Ralts work well. Watch out for Bulk Up boosting their stats. Take down Makuhita fast!

wattson.name: Wattson
wattson.title: Mauville City Gym Leader
wattson.tips: Ground types are immune and super effective! Marshtomp is perfect. Watch out for Self-Destruct from Voltorb. Magneton/Magnemite are also Steel type.

flannery.name: Flannery
flannery.title: Lavaridge Town Gym Leader
flannery.tips: Water types dominate. Ground types work but watch for Sunny Day boosting Fire moves. Torkoal's White Herb in Emerald lets it use full-power Overheat twice!

norman.name: Norman
norman.title: Petalburg City Gym Leader
norman.tips: Slaking's Truant ability makes it skip every other turn - use Protect! Fighting types crush this gym. Don't use status moves - Facade deals double damage when statused!

winona.name: Winona
winona.title: Fortree City Gym Leader
winona.tips: Electric types handle most of her team. Ice moves crush Altaria. Watch out for Altaria's Dragon Dance setup - take it down quickly! Skarmory resists Electric.

tate-liza.name: Tate & Liza
tate-liza.title: Mossdeep City Gym Leaders
tate-liza.tips: Double Battle! Dark types resist Psychic and deal super effective damage. Note: Earthquake won't work - all have Levitate! Water counters Solrock's Fire/Rock typing.

wallace-gym.name: Wallace
wallace-gym.title: Sootopolis City Gym Leader
wallace-gym.tips: Grass and Electric types dominate. Watch out for Milotic's bulk and Recover! Whiscash is Ground type, so Electric won't work on it. Seaking has Horn Drill OHKO move.

juan.name: Juan
juan.title: Sootopolis City Gym Leader
juan.tips: Juan replaced Wallace as Gym Leader in Emerald. Kingdra (Water/Dragon) is only weak to Dragon! It has Rest + Chesto Berry combo. Electric handles most, Grass handles Whiscash.

sidney.name: Sidney
sidney.title: Elite Four
sidney.tips: Fighting types destroy Dark! Heracross is perfect. Bug types like Armaldo work well. Watch out for Sharpedo's speed and Absol's Swords Dance setup.

phoebe.name: Phoebe
phoebe.title: Elite Four
phoebe.tips: Dark types resist and hit Ghost super effectively! Sableye (Dark/Ghost) has no weaknesses in Gen 3. Dusclops has high defenses - use strong special attacks.

glacia.name: Glacia
glacia.title: Elite Four
glacia.tips: Fire and Fighting types excel! Watch out for Walrein's Sheer Cold OHKO move. Glalie can use Explosion in Emerald. Sealeo/Walrein are also Water type.

drake-hoenn.name: Drake
drake-hoenn.title: Elite Four
drake-hoenn.tips: Ice types crush Dragons! Walrein, Glalie, or any Ice Beam user works. Flygon is also Ground type. Kingdra in Emerald/ORAS is Water/Dragon - only weak to Dragon!

steven.name: Steven
steven.title: Pokémon League Champion
steven.tips: Fire handles Steel types. Ground is great but Skarmory and Armaldo fly/float. Metagross is Steel/Psychic - Fire or Ground work. In ORAS, Metagross Mega Evolves!

wallace-champion.name: Wallace
wallace-champion.title: Pokémon League Champion
wallace-champion.tips: Wallace is Champion in Emerald only (Steven is in RS/ORAS). Grass types work but watch for Ice moves! Whiscash is immune to Electric. Milotic has incredible bulk and Recover.
